question.prompt: What starting URL should the web search tests open?

options.label: Use {{home_page_url}}
options.detail: Run the browser tests from the existing `home_page_url` variable once it is filled.

options.label: Provide literal URL
options.detail: Supply the concrete home page URL for this site.

options.label: Different variable
options.detail: Supply a different variable name to use as the starting URL.

content.risk_rationale: Without a concrete starting URL, none of the web tests can run even though their assertions are fully designed.
